newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-MCLAREN IN PARTNERSHIP WITH BRITISH AEROSPACE.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-MCLAREN IN PARTNERSHIP WITH BRITISH AEROSPACE.

text.p: McLaren motor racing team confirmed plans for a technical 'take-off' on Tuesday when they announced they were forming a five-year partnership with British Aerospace.
The Formula One team said they had agreed to share their technical expertise, particularly for design development, and would work together on a lot of development programmes.
British Aerospace is Britain's biggest manufacturing exporter and exported more than 4.5 billion pounds ($7.4 billion) worth of goods in 1995. ($ = 0.611 British Pounds)
